title: Resilient Structured Generation
instructions: Implement `extract_json` and the async `generate_validated` loop in `resilient_gen.py` (the dataclasses and exceptions are provided). Treat truncation (`finish_reason == "length"`), invalid content and unusable stops differently: truncation doubles the token cap with the same prompt, invalid content spends a bounded repair, and `content_filter` or other reasons fail at once. Keep echoed text and error summaries bounded and never mutate the caller's messages.

evidence.label: extract_json finds the first balanced object, respects strings, escapes and fences, and rejects bad input
A valid first reply costs exactly one call
Truncation doubles max_tokens and retries the same messages without repairs
Truncation at the cap raises TruncatedOutput
Invalid output is repaired by echoing the output and the validation error
A content_filter stop fails immediately without a repair
Echoed output (2,000 chars) and error text (500 chars) are bounded
The caller's messages list is not mutated
Truncation does not consume the repair budget and keeps the grown cap
